text: Cooking involves heating food to a certain temperature for an extended period of time. Simmering, a gentle form of cooking, is when food is placed in a pot or pan and heated on low heat. This process creates a flavorful sauce or liquid. Once simmering is complete, it is important to remove the heat and allow the dish to rest, allowing the flavors to meld together. Seasoning should be added after the dish has cooled down, allowing it to develop the most flavorful taste.
